description: Renovate for TryGhost/pro-helm-charts. Everything is review-required; nothing automerges.

packageRules.description: bjw-s common (Chart.yaml dependency). Renovate bumps the dependency and refreshes Chart.lock (helmUpdateSubChartArchives). values.schema.json embeds common's schema and must be regenerated by a human in the same PR; CI fails until it is.
prBodyNotes: 1. Regenerate `charts/ghost-app/values.schema.json` (README: *Updating common*). CI fails until it matches the locked common schema.

2. Bump `version` in `charts/ghost-app/Chart.yaml`. Renovate bumps **patch** for minor/patch common updates and does **not** bump for major updates: decide yourself whether ghost-app's public values API changed, and use a **major** ghost-app bump with migration notes if it did.
3. Read the upstream release notes and upgrade guide linked below; render `examples/scheduler` and compare.

packageRules.description: Minor/patch common updates: Renovate bumps ghost-app's patch version so the PR is releasable as-is (still review-required).
Major common updates: compatibility PR. No automatic chart version bump; a human picks the ghost-app version (usually major) and writes the migration notes.
git-sync image in ghost-app values.yaml (helm-values manager). No digest pinning: the tag is rendered as image:tag.
prBodyNotes: Bump `version` in `charts/ghost-app/Chart.yaml` (patch) before merging; CI enforces it. Renovate cannot bump it for values.yaml changes.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: keep SHA pins, review-required, group minors/patches.
